name: Every screen meets WCAG 2.2 AA
says: every WCAG 2.2 success criterion at levels A and AA, from W3C's own wcag.json pinned by SHA-256, is enforced as the standards registry says (axe-core 4.10.3 rules, verified not-applicable conditions, or W3C's test procedures as probes) on the first visit, every place in the person's view, an opened item, Settings and an answer, at desktop and phone widths in light and dark, on the specifications' own examples

measures.says: WCAG 2.2 A and AA success criteria failing beyond the standard's listed debt
